QuestInfo.name: Inverse Attributes
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2020005##k said he will conduct an experiment with the ingredients, and told me to come back to him in a little bit.
QuestInfo.1: I tried the experiment with b#p2020005##k but unfortunately it failed.  #b#p2020005##k told me to go to see #b#p2030012##k, an expert on magic ingredients.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p2030012##k said the inverse attributes is a bunch of nonsense. Nevertheless, he seemed intrigued by it and told me to go see #b#p2012017##k, the mad scientist in Orbis.

0.0: You gathered everything but unfortunately, the experiment didn't work out.
0.1: Not that I totally failed. I found out why inverse element-based magic doesn't work. The magic itself doesn't have any problem. There's something wrong with the #bmagic ingredients#k.
0.2: So I will change the ingredients and continue to work on it. It's troublesome and hard. But, that's what science is. You'll help me right?

yes.0: I thought you would say so. Do you know #b#p2030012##k? He's been studying for a long time at the #bOrbis tower#k and knows everything about ingredients. He can help.

no.0: You look tired of gathering ingredients. Whenever you feel like studying, come back.

1.0: Coughing...Hmm. What made you come here? Adventurers don't come this far. What can I do for you? \r\n#b#L0#I'm studying the inverse element-based magic with #p2020005#. I need your help.#l
1.1: I know #b#p2020005##k. He has a really strange theory. Inverse element-based magic? It can't be real.\r\n#b#L0#It's a magicians job to make everything possible.#l
1.2: If it was possible, many magicians would have learned it already. It's interesting theory though...

yes.0: It might be possible. Why don't you ask a scientist?
yes.1: Do you know #b#p2012017##k? He is concerned with magic as well as science. Ask him for help.

npc.0: Don't you know where #b#p2030012##k is? He's in the corner of Orbis tower.
